prompt:
Create a refined EDIT of the Chinese historical strategy game UI in IMAGE 1. IMAGE 1 is the editable target and approved dark atmosphere; IMAGE 2 is only a reference for the CLOSER horizontal spacing. The new spacing must be visibly HALFWAY BETWEEN them. Do not adopt image2's open selection panel. This is a final art-direction polish, not a new design. Keep the whole16:9 screen, exact Chinese wording, quiet low-contrast dark night-camp background, and regular KAISHU 楷体 lettering.

SPATIAL COMPOSITION:
Image1 is overly spread to the edges. Bring the left cluster INWARD/RIGHT and right cluster INWARD/LEFT, to a balanced middle distance.
At approximately1672x940:
- The current question “不惊扰丞相，军情该交给谁？” begins at x=315,y=310.
- Evidence “今夜不得入帐” begins at x=370,y=373; “伯约受命接报” begins at x=410,y=431. A subtle40px stagger gives natural branching without mess. Each has a tiny translucent same-row ×.
- BOTH right node titles begin on the EXACT same vertical axis x=1110: initial thought “今夜有变，可能试探” at y=215; new outcome “向姜维请求接报” at y=400. Use identical font size and weight for these two labels.
- Keep the two small supporting lines directly below the outcome, all aligned x=1110: “先请他在帐外听报。” / “是否应允，仍须当面问准。”; the discreet action “去见姜维” below.
- At y=505 below the left evidence cluster, small “＋ 添入线索” and compact matte cinnabar “推理” button, grouped together. Selection slip is CLOSED: no options or large panel visible.
- Thus the question/result span is around800px, not image1's1070px and not image2's610px. Visible evidence-to-result connection lengths roughly400px. This must look like comfortable optical balance and a single thought composition, not two separate islands. Do not stretch to screen edges.
- Header “思绪” / “收起”, footer “回看前文” / “回到最新” stay quiet.

CRITICAL LINE REFINEMENT — WISPY INK, NOT DIAGRAM WIRES:
Redraw all connections as exceptionally delicate, faint warm-grey ink threads, only about HALF the visual prominence of image1. Hairline weight, soft antialiased edge, subtle tapering, tiny natural changes of opacity with occasional almost-invisible sections like dry ink losing pressure. Keep each route visually traceable. NOT regularly dashed lines, dotted lines, glowing lines, white ropes or decorative smoke. Gentle curves with small amplitudes, no exaggerated S bends.
Topology remains: the initial thought at upper right connects to the right edge of the CURRENT QUESTION, and occurs ONLY ONCE. No duplicated inherited clue. The question softly branches to the two evidence nodes. Two independent shallow threads from the evidence join gently only just before the new result. No arrowheads, no endpoint circles, no extra connections, no crossing text. Lines should seem to dissolve into node washes at each end, not attach to hard borders.

MATERIAL AND HIERARCHY — REMOVE THE LABEL-STICKER LOOK:
Current rough rectangular ink strips are too thick, too opaque, too uniformly jagged and look pasted on. Replace them with very thin translucent grey-ink underwashes: no hard rectangular outline, no chunky scalloped/torn cardboard edge, no thick strip shadow. Irregularity is tiny and delicate, with softly feathered tapered ends. Text remains clearly readable and clickable in the later implementation.
The initial thought is the quietest: nearly no underwash, warm grey text, still legible. Evidence has a slightly more present charcoal wash. The new result has a subtle fine ivory-grey undertone behind the lettering, never a gold bar or light blob. Current question and new result are the two primary readable anchors. Supporting text recedes gently but is not washed out. All Chinese words use the SAME regular KAISHU, not Songti or sans. Only TWO SMALL scales, body about16-17px at this image width, question and both right titles about20-21px. Do not enlarge any text into a poster heading. The new outcome must NOT have a bigger font than the initial thought.
The question's red mark is a slender understated stroke, not a bright orange blob. The 推理 button is compact about100x34px, matte low-saturation deep cinnabar #884b3e with a faint dry-pressed texture, no embossed decorative motifs, orange glow or shiny border. Use small ivory KaiTi wording. The plus and × signs are delicate and quieter than text.

BACKGROUND:
Retain the low-contrast ink-painted camp and flags along bottom and far side margins. Reduce central woven/flower texture contrast slightly so the space behind the words is still and clear, no muddy mottling. Preserve atmospheric depth at lower edge; no bright tent, fire, moon, spotlight, character or scenery focal point. Keep the palette warm charcoal, muted grey ivory and very sparing deep cinnabar.
The result should feel materially integrated, calm, mature and carefully composed: a compact vertically grouped, moderately wide mind map with visual hierarchy and almost weightless connecting ink. Do not add any content, panels, explanation labels, historical clues, badges or large symbols.
